entries.title: II Corinthians 6:1
segments: As a worker with him I beseech you not to receive the grace of God in vain.

entries.title: II Corinthians 6:2
segments: For he said: In an acceptable time have I heard thee, And in the day of salvation have I succored thee. Behold, now is the acceptable time! behold, now is the day of salvation!

entries.title: II Corinthians 6:3
segments: I am giving no one a cause of stumbling in order that my ministry may not be discredited;

entries.title: II Corinthians 6:4
segments: but in every way I am striving to commend myself as God's minister by stedfast endurance, by afflictions, by troubles, by distresses,

entries.title: II Corinthians 6:5
segments: by floggings, by imprisonment; in riots, in labors, in sleepless watching, in hunger and thirst;

entries.title: II Corinthians 6:6
segments: with purity, understanding, patience, and kindness; by the Holy Spirit, by love sincere,

entries.title: II Corinthians 6:7
segments: by a true teaching and an energy divine; by the weapons of righteousness, for attack or for defense,

entries.title: II Corinthians 6:8
segments: amid honor or dishonor, amid evil report and good report; as a deceiver and yet true;

entries.title: II Corinthians 6:9
segments: as unknown and yet well known; as at death's door, yet, strange to tell, I live on; as chastened, but not killed;

entries.title: II Corinthians 6:10
segments: as grieved, but always glad; as poor, but making many rich; as having nothing, yet possessing everything.

entries.title: II Corinthians 6:11
segments: O Corinthians, I am unsealing my lips to you; my heart is wide open to you.

entries.title: II Corinthians 6:12
segments: There is no narrowness in my love; but the narrowness is in your own.

entries.title: II Corinthians 6:13
segments: I pray you, therefore, in fair exchange (I speak as to my children), let your hearts also be wide open to me.

entries.title: II Corinthians 6:14
segments: [Be not unequally yoked with unbelievers; for what fellowship has righteousness with lawlessness? what communion has light with darkness?

entries.title: II Corinthians 6:15
segments: What concord has Christ with Belial? What portion has a believer with an unbeliever?

entries.title: II Corinthians 6:16
segments: And what compact has God's temple with idols? For we are a temple of the living God, as he has said: I will dwell among them, and walk about among them; I will be their God, and they will be my people.

entries.title: II Corinthians 6:17
segments: Therefore, Come out from among them and separate yourselves, saith the Lord, touch not what is unclean;

entries.title: II Corinthians 6:18
segments: then I will receive you and will be to you a Father, and you shall be to me sons and daughters, saith the Lord Almighty.
